title: CesTesterScenario
description: ces-tester scenario file schema v1 - FREEZE BASELINE (Step 0 schema insurance, 2026-07-11, cross-cutting O1). M3 implements the loader/validator against THIS file; the two reserved fields below (lanes, muster.readiness_payload) are part of the frozen interface and must survive into the M3 build. Skeleton source: PLAN.md sec. 'schema today' (lines ~96-127).

scenario_id.description: Becomes stacksim's required top-level 'name' when the seed block is materialized.

lanes.description: RESERVED (schema insurance): which tenant lanes this scenario runs on. Dual-tenant parity is first-class: the same scenario file must be runnable on both lanes and verifier verdicts (result.json shape) must be bit-identical across sim and live. The live lane stays BLOCKED-ON-FD-LIVE-SMOKE-HOLD; until it opens, validators accept only ["sim"]. A scenario whose lanes and seed disagree (e.g. lanes includes "sim" but no stacksim_seed) must be REJECTED by the M3 validator.

stacksim_seed.description: stacksim's own schema (ScenarioEngine.ts) - the orchestrator splices 'name': scenario_id at top level and materializes to <tempdir>/<scenario_id>.json. Kept loose here; stacksim validates its own format. Required when lanes includes 'sim'; absent for live-only scenarios.

answer_map.description: Question-id -> answer map driven through Muster's wizard (data-question-id DOM hooks).

plan_source.description: Flow-through MS-R10 (2026-09-27, additive): source the Mission Plan from ces-muster's REAL generator (buildPlanArtifacts) instead of driving the legacy ces-planner wizard. SIT answers come from the answer_map rows whose wizard is 'sit' (real SI-bank question ids); requirement_results is the readiness posture Muster feeds the generator.

readiness_payload.description: RESERVED (schema insurance): injects a readiness-result.v1 payload fixture into the scenario, consumed via Muster's import seam once the readiness lane is driven by tester. The payload format is ces-muster's public/schemas/readiness-result.schema.json (readiness-result/1.0.0) - THE import-file format, no second format ever. fixture_ref points at a payload file relative to the scenario file.

schema_version.description: Pin: the fixture must validate against this payload schema version.

expected_state.description: Verified against stacksim /resolve (sim lane) or the live read path (live lane).

expected_evidence.description: Verified against Stamper's local evidence + stacksim /evidence (capture_received defers to the M7 EO lane per PHASE0_FINDINGS item 5).
